events.rationale: FACT: As of 2026-09-18 AUDCAD spot is 0.9975768872320596, 1y percentile 99.80 and 5y percentile 99.96, with +1.95% 1m and +1.37% 3m; 20d realized vol is 4.38. AUDUSD is only 76.4 1y / 84.3 5y and USDCAD 74.0 1y / 87.0 5y, so the extreme lives in the product of two moderate USD legs, not in either dollar pair. Overnight AONIA is 4.35 with Oct +21.5bp and Mar-27 +51bp (implied 4.86); CORRA is 2.29 with Dec 1m +29bp and Mar-27 +84bp (implied 3.13). AU 2Y is 4.999 at the 99th percentile 1y/5y; CA 2Y is 3.27 at 97.8 1y but only 58.5 5y; CA-AU 2Y is -164.9bp at the 10.5th 5y percentile. AU temperature: inflation 82, labor 50, activity 54, consumer 48. CA: inflation 55, labor 38, activity 66, consumer 45. NSW stamp-duty receipts fell 24% y/y in August with transactions -18% and Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% below peak. Canada August CPI held at 3% with core near 2%; BoC minutes flag energy pass-through. The book already owns short AUDCAD pos-00661cabb94a, 50m notional, 500k standard-shock risk, mark equal to packet mid. INFERENCE: the market is pricing an RBA-over-BoC currency premium as if Australia can keep tightening from 4.35 into an already-open housing channel while Canada remains a cheap overnight and a cheap CAD in the cross. That is backwards on the remaining path: AONIA has less unused hike room into deteriorating housing, CORRA still prices a catch-up cycle, and energy pass-through is a CAD-specific catalyst. Short AUDCAD owns that differential without a Fed/USD residual. USD expressions (short AUDUSD or long USDCAD) contaminate a clean AU-versus-CA view with the just-delivered Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% and with SOFR 3.85. AUDNZD is also a 5y extreme but NZ official yields and the NZ policy path are unavailable in this packet, so it is not a cleaner cross. Carry opposes the short (AONIA 4.35 versus CORRA 2.29), which is why the book HOLDs 50m rather than ADDs. UNKNOWN: NZ rates, CME FX futures positioning, broker executable quotes, and any labeled historical analog with quantified forward outcomes.

AUDUSD is only the 76.4th 1y percentile and USDCAD the 74.0th; the 1m cross gain is almost entirely USDCAD +1.74%, not AUDUSD. AONIA is 4.35 with +51bp to Mar-27; CORRA is 2.29 with +84bp to 3.13. Book action is HOLD, not a second OPEN and not an ADD into negative carry.
